Subject: Re: POC next steps and success criteria

Hi Alicia / Ben — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC plan: 

Summary / success criteria (please confirm):
- Ingest sample EMR snippets and return clinical summarizations that match HarborHealth SME expectations (target F1 > 0.75 on our shared eval set).
- Latency: tail p95 generation < 200ms for short prompts (<= 128 tokens) and average token cost within the committed trial profile.
- Data handling: all PHI stays in HarborHealth VPC during private trial; Redwood only receives request metadata per the integration design.
- Quality gates: no flagged PHI leakage cases in the evaluation set; customer manual review of 50 random responses.

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (prep): access to staging AWS account, VPN details, and sample datasets (anonymized).
- Week 1 (8/24 start): baseline model run + integration (live API calls to staging).
- Week 2 (9/1): refinement + final eval and business sign-off.

Ownership ask (we need names/emails):
- Infra / cloud owner at HarborHealth (for VPN, IAM, staging account access)
- App product owner who will validate summaries
- Security/compliance point of contact for evidence (SOC 2-ish checklist and required attestations)
- Procurement contact for quote/PO timeline

Proposed kickoff: Mon 8/24 10:00 AM PT — 30 minute technical + logistics sync. If that works, I’ll send calendar invite and a short prep checklist.

Attached to follow: our standard POC checklist and an initial RACI draft (will share in a follow-up email).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
